svg.title: Immediate feature operation — conceptual workflow schematic
svg.desc: Original diagram, not an application screenshot. One unified list has Known content (153) and Historical references (60) checked by default, and Show unknown (16,944) unchecked. Every page has at most twelve cards, with search and filters above and pagination below. A separate Enter ID field accepts a single decimal nonzero uint32 value, including unlisted IDs, on paste and Enter for read-only inspection. It does not execute shell input, change a feature, alter filters or claim availability. These visibility filters are distinct from execution. Exact numeric hidden matches prompt for the filter, never auto-expose content. Known purpose is not proof of Windows support; unknown purpose is not unknown observed state. Select an eligible raw feature ID, use one Enable checkbox, respond to Windows UAC if needed, then inspect the observed override state and read-only history. Checking enables; unchecking explicitly disables. Restore default is a separate per-feature action. Historical entries are read-only and native guides only navigate.

g.text: Filter one list. Then operate the selected feature.
ORIGINAL WORKFLOW SCHEMATIC · Not an actual UI screenshot · Native Windows rendering is pending
VISIBILITY ONLY · ONE SEARCHABLE LIST · NO FILTER DROPDOWNS
Exact numeric match hidden? Prompt for its filter; never silently reveal it or change filter choices.
Known purpose ≠ Windows support. Unknown purpose ≠ unknown observed system state.
12 CARDS MAX PER PAGE, INCLUDING UNKNOWN · SEARCH/FILTERS ABOVE · PAGER BELOW CARDS
Separate Enter ID → paste one decimal nonzero uint32 → press Enter → read-only inspection
Unlisted IDs accepted; availability unknown. No shell execution, feature change, or change to search filters.
Restore default is a separate action for the selected ID: it removes the explicit user override.
Historical feature archives remain read-only. Native settings and guides only open documented destinations.
Original ViVeUI illustration · GPL-3.0-or-later · Conceptual operation flow, not a rendered Windows control tree
